rows.grounds: agent who attains the described state
state of completeness reached by the practitioner
prior action leading to the resulting condition
compound describing sovereign mastery over all enjoyments

items.question: What status results for the practitioner upon attaining fullness?
premises: Attaining fullness precedes a transformed status.
The resulting status is lordship over all enjoyments.
items.inference: Therefore, upon attaining fullness, the practitioner may become lord of all enjoyments.
uncertainties: Whether bhoga refers to sensory enjoyments, experiential powers, or both is not specified.
items.plain_english: Having attained fullness, the practitioner may become the lord of all enjoyments.
